caption: The drawing depicts a piece of rectangular, light beige or off-white fabric laid flat against a plain, similarly colored background. The fabric contains embroidered letters and numbers in brown thread, organized mostly in rows with some irregular spacing. The upper row has letters "O P Q R S T ___ Y Z" and the letters "C" and "B O R" appear underneath, spaced apart. The letters "H A N C" and "I L 28 1780" are stitched prominently near the center. Some additional small motifs or symbols, such as diamond and cross shapes, are stitched near the lower area of the fabric. The edges of the fabric appear slightly worn with some visible spots and brownish stains, especially near the corners. There is a subtle white or light-colored border stitch outlining the edges. The background is unadorned, and a faint rectangular border is drawn around the fabric, with small printed text in the bottom corners reading "Actual Size" on the left and "Paul Smith" on the right.
title: Embroidery Sampler
